summary.tldr: Designates October 22 as a national day to remember Canadian Armed Forces members who died on Canadian soil during peacetime.
what_it_does: Designates October 22 each year across Canada as Peacetime Service and Sacrifice Memorial Day.
States that the day is meant to encourage Canadians to remember and honour Canadian Armed Forces members who lost their lives on Canadian soil during peacetime.
Requires the national flag of Canada on the Peace Tower to be lowered to half-mast on that day.
summary.background: The bill creates a national day of remembrance for Canadian Armed Forces members who lost their lives in peacetime in Canada.
